method.grouping: one edge = one RAMM road id (ramm_road_id), named by ramm_alias
method.inference: An edge's numbers are INFERRED: a sensor's reading is spread along the street it sits on, decaying to zero at 300 m. It is not a measurement of that whole stretch of street, and it is not established cause.
method.unjudged_rule: Fewer than 2 contributing sensors means one camera is speaking for the whole edge. Rank it, grey it, do not call an anomaly on it.
method.forecast: Same-weekday same-hour median per camera site over the pool ending the day before the week started, x the citywide trend factor. Out of sample for every hour in the week.
